# `congress_sessions`

**Congressional session dates reconciled across House and Senate**

Official Congress session beginning and adjournment dates reconciled between the House Historian session-dates page and the Senate Historical Office party-division page.

**Coverage.** Window. Reconciled House Historian and Senate Historical Office session tables from the 1st Congress through the current Congress as of the captured pages. *(measured 2026-11-25)*

- **Parquet file:** `congress_sessions.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `congress` | `INTEGER` | Congress number (1st Congress onward). |
| `session` | `VARCHAR` | Reconciled session label (such as 1, 2, special, or 1 (senate-special)). |
| `begins` | `DATE` | Reconciled session start date. |
| `adjourned` | `DATE` | Reconciled session adjournment date; null when open or unstated by the source. |
| `adjournment_status` | `VARCHAR` | Adjourned, open for an active session, or unstated when a historical source prints no end date. |
| `house_session` | `VARCHAR` | Session label as listed on the House Historian page; null when Senate-only. |
| `house_begins` | `DATE` | Session start date printed by the House Historian; null when Senate-only. |
| `house_adjourned` | `DATE` | Session adjournment date printed by the House Historian; null when open, unstated, or Senate-only. |
| `senate_session` | `VARCHAR` | Normalized session label from the Senate Historical Office page; null when House-only. |
| `senate_begins` | `DATE` | Session start date printed by the Senate Historical Office; null when House-only. |
| `senate_adjourned` | `DATE` | Session adjournment date printed by the Senate Historical Office; null when open, unstated, or House-only. |
| `disagreement_kind` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit reconciliation category when House and Senate pages differ, otherwise null. |
| `correction_reason` | `VARCHAR` | Explanation for an applied source correction or disagreement resolution, otherwise null. |
| `house_source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Official House Historian session-dates URL. |
| `house_source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained House Historian session-dates HTML page. |
| `house_observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC timestamp when the House Historian session-dates page was captured. |
| `senate_source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Official Senate Historical Office party-division URL. |
| `senate_source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained Senate Historical Office party-division HTML page. |
| `senate_observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC timestamp when the Senate Historical Office party-division page was captured. |
